name: Moped
description: A motor-driven cycle, so a motor of no more than 5 horsepower (3,750 W), whose speed attainable in one mile is 30 mph or less. The 50 cc and no-shifting limits apply only to an internal combustion engine, so an electric motor qualifies on speed and power alone. Electric bicycles are excluded.

restrictions.rule: A motor-driven cycle: a motorcycle or motor scooter with a motor of no more than 5 horsepower (3,750 W), or a bicycle with a motor attached that isn't an electric bicycle
Can reach no more than 30 mph within one mile (New Hampshire RSA 259:57)
Not a motorcycle under state law
Riders need a driver's license from any state, a motorcycle license, or a restricted moped license earned by passing a written exam
No statewide helmet requirement: the helmet law for riders under 18 covers motorcycles, which exclude mopeds
Registered with the Division of Motor Vehicles, with a moped plate distinct from a motorcycle's; no municipal registration permit is needed
